s0401.literal: On jihai day the moon transgressed Fang.
s0401.idiomatic: On jihai day the moon transgressed Fang.

s0402.literal: On renyin day the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.
s0402.idiomatic: On renyin day the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.

s0403.literal: On guimao day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was appointed left grand councillor of the Japan Expedition Branch Secretariat, retaining the titles of imperial son-in-law and King of Goryeo.
s0403.idiomatic: On guimao day King Wang Chun of Goryeo was appointed left grand councillor of the Japan expedition branch secretariat, retaining the titles of imperial son-in-law and King of Goryeo.

s0404.literal: On yisi day the Privy Council was ordered to assemble military officers to deliberate on the Japan expedition; Cheng Pengfei asked that rewards and punishments be made clear, that the meritorious receive verification credentials at the front and be formally appointed upon return, and this was approved.
s0404.idiomatic: On yisi day the Privy Council was ordered to assemble military officers to deliberate on the Japan expedition; Cheng Pengfei asked that rewards and punishments be made clear, that the meritorious receive verification credentials at the front and be formally appointed upon return, and the request was approved.

s0405.literal: On gengxu day right vice chancellor Yesudai'er pacified the peoples of Junlian, Ding, Ayong, Duzhang, and other places; the Dushan Duzhang people would not submit, so he advanced to attack them, captured alive their chief Delanniu, and then withdrew the army.
s0405.idiomatic: On gengxu day right vice chancellor Yesudai'er pacified the peoples of Junlian, Ding, Ayong, Duzhang, and other places; the Dushan Duzhang people would not submit, so he advanced against them, captured their chief Delanniu alive, and withdrew.

s0406.literal: Muslim catapults made at Dadu and their artisans Zhang Lin and others were dispatched to the Japan Expedition Branch Secretariat.
s0406.idiomatic: Muslim catapults made at Dadu and their artisans Zhang Lin and others were sent to the Japan expedition branch secretariat.

s0407.literal: On xinhai day, for the campaign against Japan, clothing and armor were granted to the Rear Guard Army, and paper currency to the newly submitted armies of Daming and Weihui.
s0407.idiomatic: On xinhai day, for the campaign against Japan, clothing and armor were granted to the Rear Guard Army and paper currency to the newly submitted armies of Daming and Weihui.

s0408.literal: Maishuding and others audited the Treasury of Myriad Myriads; because many persons imprisoned on charges were involved, they asked that the case be transferred to Mongol officials.
s0408.idiomatic: Maishuding and others audited the Treasury of Myriad Myriads; because many persons imprisoned on charges were involved, they asked that the case be transferred to Mongol officials.

s0409.literal: An imperial instruction said: "Mongols tainted by profit are no longer as in former days; let those fit for appointment be selected and entrusted."
s0409.idiomatic: An imperial instruction said, "Mongols tainted by profit are no longer as in former days; let those fit for appointment be selected and entrusted."

s0410.literal: Fifth month, on yimao day, summer clothing was issued to the garrison troops of Ganzhou.
s0410.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yimao day, summer clothing was issued to the garrison troops of Ganzhou.

s0411.literal: On wuwu day Chancellor Bayan, Prince Xiangwada'er, and others said: "The army campaigning against Burma should employ both Mongol and newly submitted troops.
s0411.idiomatic: On wuwu day Chancellor Bayan, Prince Xiangwada'er, and others said, "The army campaigning against Burma should employ both Mongol and newly submitted troops.

s0413.literal: On jiwei day the five guard armies were exempted from the Japan expedition, and ten thousand men were sent to Shangdu.
s0413.idiomatic: On jiwei day the five guard armies were exempted from the Japan expedition and 10,000 men were sent to Shangdu.

s0414.literal: Shipbuilding troops of Pingluan were released to return to farming, and troops under Dadu's direct command were assigned to take their place.
s0414.idiomatic: Pingluan shipbuilding troops were released to return to farming, and troops under Dadu's direct command were assigned to take their place.

s0415.literal: On gengshen day ninety-nine salt-administration officials of Gaili Saltworks in Chang Prefecture of Longxing were reduced, and the affair was placed under Longxing Prefecture.
s0415.idiomatic: On gengshen day ninety-nine salt-administration officials of Gaili Saltworks in Chang Prefecture of Longxing were cut, and the affair was placed under Longxing Prefecture.

s0416.literal: Official fields for Jiangnan civil officials and transport commissioners were fixed.
s0416.idiomatic: Official fields for Jiangnan civil officials and transport commissioners were fixed.

s0417.literal: On jiazi day gold-washing laborers of Yangzhou were transferred to Yidu.
s0417.idiomatic: On jiazi day gold-washing laborers of Yangzhou were transferred to Yidu.

s0418.literal: The Japan Expedition Branch Secretariat was established; the King of Goryeo and Atahai were to serve together, and clothing and armor for Goryeo's Japan expedition army were granted.
s0418.idiomatic: The Japan expedition branch secretariat was established; the King of Goryeo and Atahai were to serve together, and clothing and armor for Goryeo's Japan expedition army were granted.

s0419.literal: Censor-in-chief Cui Yu said: "Bandits in Jiangnan have risen one after another, all because sailors are conscripted and sea ships are built, until the people cannot survive; the Japan expedition should for the time being be halted.
s0419.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Cui Yu said, "Bandits in Jiangnan have risen one after another, all because sailors are conscripted and sea ships are built until the people cannot survive; the Japan expedition should for the time being be halted.

s0420.literal: The four Jiangnan provinces supplying military needs should measure the people's strength, not force them to supply what their lands do not produce, and whenever prices or goods are taken from the people they must be paid in full.
s0420.idiomatic: The four Jiangnan provinces supplying military needs should measure the people's strength, not force them to supply what their lands do not produce, and whenever prices or goods are taken from the people they must be paid in full.

s0421.literal: When recruiting sailors, their wishes should be followed.
s0421.idiomatic: When recruiting sailors, their wishes should be followed.

s0422.literal: When the people's spirits have somewhat revived and our strength is roughly prepared, another eastern expedition in two or three years would not be late.
s0422.idiomatic: When the people's spirits have somewhat revived and our strength is roughly prepared, another eastern expedition in two or three years would not be late.

s0424.literal: On bingyin day the moon eclipsed the eastern star of Heart.
s0424.idiomatic: On bingyin day the moon eclipsed the eastern star of Heart.

s0425.literal: Two-thirds of Jiangnan grain tax was remitted.
s0425.idiomatic: Two-thirds of Jiangnan grain tax was remitted.

s0426.literal: An edict ordered Ala Haiya to deploy seven thousand Han troops and eight thousand newly submitted troops and assign them to Suodu for the campaign.
s0426.idiomatic: An edict ordered Ala Haiya to deploy 7,000 Han troops and 8,000 newly submitted troops and assign them to Suodu for the campaign.

s0427.literal: On xinwei day the Champa branch secretariat had already broken Champa; its king Budi fled, and an imperial letter was issued to summon him to submit.
s0427.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Champa branch secretariat had already broken Champa; its king Budi fled, and an imperial letter was issued to summon him to submit.

s0428.literal: On jiaxu day heavy criminals from the Japan expedition were sent to Champa, Burma, and other places to join the campaign.
s0428.idiomatic: On jiaxu day heavy criminals from the Japan expedition were sent to Champa, Burma, and other places to join the campaign.

s0429.literal: Four agriculture-promotion officials were established for Goryeo.
s0429.idiomatic: Four agriculture-promotion officials were established for Goryeo.

s0430.literal: On bingzi day an edict instructed Prince Xiangwada'er: "Formerly serious criminals in Yunnan were allowed summary execution at convenience, for fear of implicating the innocent; from now on all capital crimes must still await imperial confirmation.
s0430.idiomatic: On bingzi day an edict instructed Prince Xiangwada'er, "Formerly serious criminals in Yunnan were allowed summary execution at convenience for fear of implicating the innocent; from now on all capital crimes must still await imperial confirmation.

s0431.literal: " The prefectures and districts of Jianghuai and Yunnan were also consolidated.
s0431.idiomatic: " The prefectures and districts of Jianghuai and Yunnan were also consolidated.

s0432.literal: Yelü Laoge was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.
s0432.idiomatic: Yelü Laoge was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.

s0433.literal: Corvée tax on garrison troops was remitted.
s0433.idiomatic: Corvée tax on garrison troops was remitted.

s0434.literal: Princes' ordu officials were forbidden to levy exactions on military households.
s0434.idiomatic: Princes' ordu officials were forbidden to levy exactions on military households.

s0435.literal: Because southwestern barbarians were plotting rebellion and had not yet submitted, the Sichuan army campaigning against Burma was exempted and ordered to guard exclusively; funds were disbursed for each relay station to supply them.
s0435.idiomatic: Because southwestern barbarians were plotting rebellion and had not yet submitted, the Sichuan army campaigning against Burma was exempted and ordered to guard exclusively, and funds were disbursed for each relay station to supply them.

s0436.literal: On wuyin day all memorialists were gathered for deliberation at the metropolitan secretariat; what was feasible was reported upward, and what was not was clearly explained to the memorialists.
s0436.idiomatic: On wuyin day all memorialists were gathered for deliberation at the metropolitan secretariat; what was feasible was reported upward, and what was not was clearly explained to the memorialists.

s0437.literal: Surveillance commissioners were permitted to use bows and arrows.
s0437.idiomatic: Surveillance commissioners were permitted to use bows and arrows.

s0438.literal: Supervising censor Alahun was dismissed on charges of arbitrarily remitting fine money and failing to investigate private brewing.
s0438.idiomatic: Supervising censor Alahun was dismissed on charges of arbitrarily remitting fine money and failing to investigate private brewing.

s0439.literal: Following Censor-in-chief Cui Yu's memorial, the selection of maidens in all routes was abolished.
s0439.idiomatic: Following censor-in-chief Cui Yu's memorial, the selection of maidens in all routes was abolished.

s0440.literal: The small-capacity hu of the Song Wensi Court was promulgated for use.
s0440.idiomatic: The small-capacity hu of the Song Wensi Court was promulgated for use.

s0441.literal: An edict ordered that fine money from the Shaanxi surveillance commission be delivered to the Prince of Qin.
s0441.idiomatic: An edict ordered that fine money from the Shaanxi surveillance commission be delivered to the Prince of Qin.

s0442.literal: One associate deputy commissioner and one registrar of the Beijing Circuit surveillance commission were cut.
s0442.idiomatic: One associate deputy commissioner and one registrar of the Beijing circuit surveillance commission were cut.

s0443.literal: The Maritime and Eastern Liaodong Circuit Surveillance Commission was established to investigate the Jurchen and Sushen tribes.
s0443.idiomatic: The Maritime and Eastern Liaodong circuit surveillance commission was established to investigate the Jurchen and Sushen tribes.

s0444.literal: On jimao day Prince Zhibietemu'er was compensated with one hundred thousand ingots of paper currency for sheep and horses supplied to the army.
s0444.idiomatic: On jimao day Prince Zhibietemu'er was compensated with 100,000 ingots of paper currency for sheep and horses supplied to the army.

s0445.literal: Hainan Four Prefectures pacification commissioner Zhu Guobao asked for additional troops to campaign against the King of Champa; an edict granted him fifteen thousand men from Ala Haiya's army.
s0445.idiomatic: Hainan Four Prefectures pacification commissioner Zhu Guobao asked for additional troops to campaign against the King of Champa; an edict granted him 15,000 men from Ala Haiya's army.

s0446.literal: Following Wang Jiweng's memorial, an edict directed that Jiangnan grain be transported by the two routes of Abaqchi's newly opened Shenshan River and by sea.
s0446.idiomatic: Following Wang Jiweng's memorial, an edict directed that Jiangnan grain be transported by the two routes of Abaqchi's newly opened Shenshan River and by sea.

s0448.literal: On xinsi day bows, arrows, and armor were granted to Suodu of the Champa branch secretariat.
s0448.idiomatic: On xinsi day bows, arrows, and armor were granted to Suodu of the Champa branch secretariat.

s0449.literal: Sixth month, on bingxu day, the prohibition on private exchange of gold and silver was strictly enforced.
s0449.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingxu day, the prohibition on private exchange of gold and silver was strictly enforced.

s0450.literal: Ganzhou Branch Secretariat associate administrator Wang Yi was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.
s0450.idiomatic: Ganzhou branch secretariat associate administrator Wang Yi was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.

s0451.literal: This year's silk tax of Dadu and Pingluan routes was remitted.
s0451.idiomatic: This year's silk tax of Dadu and Pingluan routes was remitted.

s0452.literal: Transferred Jiangnan officials who failed to take up their posts were caned and their received patents and commissions were revoked.
s0452.idiomatic: Transferred Jiangnan officials who failed to take up their posts were caned and their received patents and commissions were revoked.

s0453.literal: On wuzi day, because of the Japan expedition, the populace was disturbed and bandits broke out in theft; Hudutemur and Mangudai asked for additional troops to suppress bandits, and an edict assigned them the armies of Xingguo and Jiangzhou.
s0453.idiomatic: On wuzi day, because of the Japan expedition, the populace was disturbed and bandits broke out; Hudutemur and Mangudai asked for additional troops to suppress them, and an edict assigned them the armies of Xingguo and Jiangzhou.

s0454.literal: On jichou day officials' salary allotments were increased.
s0454.idiomatic: On jichou day officials' salary allotments were increased.

s0455.literal: On gengyin day maritime trade assessment rates were fixed: one-tenth on fine imported goods and one-fifteenth on coarse goods.
s0455.idiomatic: On gengyin day maritime trade assessment rates were fixed: one-tenth on fine imported goods and one-fifteenth on coarse goods.

s0456.literal: Five guard army troops were assigned to repair the outer wall of the travelling palace.
s0456.idiomatic: Five guard army troops were assigned to repair the outer wall of the travelling palace.

s0457.literal: Prince Huyadu was ordered to establish judges of cases.
s0457.idiomatic: Prince Huyadu was ordered to establish judges of cases.

s0458.literal: On bingshen day troops were dispatched to repair and complete Dadu city.
s0458.idiomatic: On bingshen day troops were dispatched to repair and complete Dadu city.

s0459.literal: On xinchou day troops were dispatched to build and repair dikes and weirs.
s0459.idiomatic: On xinchou day troops were dispatched to build and repair dikes and weirs.

s0460.literal: On wushen day, following Bayan and others' memorial, the eighty-three thousand six hundred Song troops conscripted by hand-tally were organized under commanders and officials with registers and armor, and clothing and grain were still granted.
s0460.idiomatic: On wushen day, following Bayan and others' memorial, the 83,600 Song troops conscripted by hand-tally were organized under commanders and officials with registers and armor, and clothing and grain were still granted.

s0461.literal: On gengxu day Chen Diaoyan's uncle, the rebel Chen Guilong, was exiled to Handasun's territory.
s0461.idiomatic: On gengxu day Chen Diaoyan's uncle, the rebel Chen Guilong, was exiled to Handasun's territory.

s0462.literal: On xinhai day Sichuan Branch Secretariat associate administrator Qurugjin and others pacified the Nine Streams and Eighteen Caves, brought their chiefs to court, fixed their territories, established prefectures and counties, and placed them under the command of Shunyuan Route pacification commission.
s0462.idiomatic: On xinhai day Sichuan branch secretariat associate administrator Qurugjin and others pacified the Nine Streams and Eighteen Caves, brought their chiefs to court, fixed their territories, established prefectures and counties, and placed them under Shunyuan Route pacification commission.

s0463.literal: Xiang Shixiong and others were made grand pacification ambassadors and pacification commissioners of the Cha-ba caves.
s0463.idiomatic: Xiang Shixiong and others were made grand pacification ambassadors and pacification commissioners of the Cha-ba caves.

s0464.literal: Autumn, seventh month, guichou new moon: unpaid seedling tax of Jianning Route before the seventeenth year was remitted.
s0464.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the guichou new moon, unpaid seedling tax of Jianning Route before the seventeenth year was remitted.

s0465.literal: On bingchen day military levies of the Guwei tribe were remitted.
s0465.idiomatic: On bingchen day military levies of the Guwei tribe were remitted.

s0466.literal: It was instructed that Atahai's Japan expedition ships should be built somewhat more slowly;
s0466.idiomatic: It was instructed that Atahai's Japan expedition ships should be built somewhat more slowly;

s0467.literal: all detained merchant vessels should be fully returned.
s0467.idiomatic: and all detained merchant vessels should be fully returned.

s0468.literal: Alisha was executed for using false words to mislead the crowd.
s0468.idiomatic: Alisha was executed for using false words to mislead the crowd.

s0470.literal: On dingsi day pearl garments were granted to Niegudai and others.
s0470.idiomatic: On dingsi day pearl garments were granted to Niegudai and others.

s0471.literal: On gengshen day troops were transferred to reinforce the Yunnan garrison.
s0471.idiomatic: On gengshen day troops were transferred to reinforce the Yunnan garrison.

s0472.literal: On bingyin day the Yixibuxue Pacification Commission was established and additional troops were garrisoned.
s0472.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Yixibuxue pacification commission was established and additional troops were garrisoned.

s0474.literal: Yixibuxue territory was divided into three parts and officials were established to pacify and govern them.
s0474.idiomatic: Yixibuxue territory was divided into three parts and officials were established to pacify and govern them.

s0475.literal: On guihai day the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.
s0475.idiomatic: On guihai day the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.

s0476.literal: On yichou day Venus transgressed Well.
s0476.idiomatic: On yichou day Venus transgressed Well.

s0477.literal: On dingmao day the Huainan Gold-Washing Office was abolished and its households were returned to the commoner register.
s0477.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Huainan Gold-Washing Office was abolished and its households were returned to the commoner register.

s0478.literal: On gengwu day Mars transgressed Office of Strangeness.
s0478.idiomatic: On gengwu day Mars transgressed Office of Strangeness.

s0479.literal: The newly submitted official Tong Wenying came to audience; his tribute gifts were ten thousand taels of silver and forty ingots of gold — Tiemu'erbuhua concealed them as his own; an edict ordered a search of his house and confiscation to the state treasury.
s0479.idiomatic: The newly submitted official Tong Wenying came to audience with tribute of 10,000 taels of silver and 40 ingots of gold; Tiemu'erbuhua concealed them as his own, and an edict ordered a search of his house and confiscation to the state treasury.

s0480.literal: An edict ordered the arrest of Ahmad's father-in-law, Minister Cai Zhongying, and recovery of two hundred thousand ingots of government paper currency he had borrowed.
s0480.idiomatic: An edict ordered the arrest of Ahmad's father-in-law, Minister Cai Zhongying, and recovery of 200,000 ingots of government paper currency he had borrowed.

s0481.literal: Abaqchi and Yao Yan, for opening the Shenshan River bridge and canal, misappropriated two thousand four hundred ingots of government paper currency and registered seventy-three wan shi of grain fraudulently; an edict ordered recovery and further deliberation of their offenses.
s0481.idiomatic: Abaqchi and Yao Yan, for opening the Shenshan River bridge and canal, misappropriated 2,400 ingots of government paper currency and fraudulently registered 730,000 shi of grain; an edict ordered recovery and further deliberation of their offenses.

s0482.literal: On renshen day Song Tianfu, military-civilian qianhu of Yixibuxue, and Ali, military-civilian zongguan and pacification commissioner of Shunyuan Route, and others came to submit; the army withdrew, and the Luo-gui chief Ali and his followers were brought to audience.
s0482.idiomatic: On renshen day Song Tianfu, military-civilian qianhu of Yixibuxue, and Ali, military-civilian zongguan and pacification commissioner of Shunyuan Route, and others submitted; the army withdrew, and Luo-gui chief Ali and his followers were brought to audience.

s0483.literal: The Yixibuxue Headquarters was established and Ali was ordered to serve as zongguan.
s0483.idiomatic: The Yixibuxue headquarters was established and Ali was ordered to serve as zongguan.

s0484.literal: On bingzi day Jiangnan's ten-route pacification commission posts were reduced from one hundred forty to ninety-three.
s0484.idiomatic: On bingzi day Jiangnan's ten-route pacification commission posts were reduced from 140 to 93.

s0485.literal: An edict fixed Shangdu merchant tax at one-sixtieth.
s0485.idiomatic: An edict fixed Shangdu merchant tax at one-sixtieth.

s0486.literal: This year's salary paper currency of Dadu and Pingluan routes was remitted.
s0486.idiomatic: This year's salary paper currency of Dadu and Pingluan routes was remitted.

s0487.literal: The General Preceptorship was established at regular rank three.
s0487.idiomatic: The General Preceptorship was established at regular rank three.

s0488.literal: On dingchou day surveillance commissions were ordered to audit the documents of the Tibetan pacification commission.
s0488.idiomatic: On dingchou day surveillance commissions were ordered to audit the documents of the Tibetan pacification commission.

s0489.literal: Relay-station troops were established to capture bandits in Huai-xi.
s0489.idiomatic: Relay-station troops were established to capture bandits in Huai-xi.

s0490.literal: Huai-dong pacification associate commissioner Song Tingxiu privately impressed forty soldiers; he was caned and dismissed.
s0490.idiomatic: Huai-dong pacification associate commissioner Song Tingxiu privately impressed 40 soldiers; he was caned and dismissed.

s0491.literal: On gengchen day impoverished troops under Hudutemur and others were granted relief.
s0491.idiomatic: On gengchen day impoverished troops under Hudutemur and others received relief.

s0492.literal: Paper currency was paid as price for sheep and horses to Qie'erhesi and others.
s0492.idiomatic: Paper currency was paid as price for sheep and horses to Qie'erhesi and others.

s0493.literal: Eighth month, on guiwei day, Minglicha was made privy councillor with charge of state affairs and deliberated on public business.
s0493.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guiwei day, Minglicha was made privy councillor with charge of state affairs and deliberated on public business.

s0494.literal: The Huailai Gold-Washing Office was established.
s0494.idiomatic: The Huailai Gold-Washing Office was established.

s0495.literal: On jiawu day an edict ordered newly submitted armies garrisoned on the Daming, Zhending, Beijing, and Weihui routes to garrison-farm at Dongjing.
s0495.idiomatic: On jiawu day an edict ordered newly submitted armies garrisoned on the Daming, Zhending, Beijing, and Weihui routes to garrison-farm at Dongjing.

s0496.literal: Annam sent envoys bearing local products as tribute.
s0496.idiomatic: Annam sent envoys bearing local products as tribute.

s0497.literal: On bingwu day Venus transgressed Xuanyuan.
s0497.idiomatic: On bingwu day Venus transgressed Xuanyuan.

s0498.literal: On dingwei day Jupiter transgressed Gou Qian.
s0498.idiomatic: On dingwei day Jupiter transgressed Gou Qian.

s0499.literal: Zhe-xi Route pacification commissioner Shi Bi said: "Recently five hundred Japan expedition ships were levied from the people, to their distress; it would be better to take the ships Abaqchi already has, repair them, and assign them to Atahai, thereby easing the people's burden, and also grant paper currency along the coast to recruit sailors.
s0499.idiomatic: Zhe-xi Route pacification commissioner Shi Bi said, "Recently 500 Japan expedition ships were levied from the people, to their distress; it would be better to take the ships Abaqchi already has, repair them, and assign them to Atahai, thereby easing the people's burden, and also grant paper currency along the coast to recruit sailors.
